### R

#### Operators

::: panel-tabset
## Arithmetic Operators

Addition operator (+)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
200 + 175
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 375
```


:::
:::



Subtraction operator (-)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
200 - 175
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 25
```


:::
:::



Multiplication operator (\*)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
amount <- 200 * 175
amount
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 35000
```


:::
:::



Division operator (/)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
200 / 175
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 1.142857
```


:::
:::



Power operator (\^)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
200 ^ 5
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 3.2e+11
```


:::
:::



Modulo operator (%%)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 %% 2
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 %% 4
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 2
```


:::
:::



## Relational Operators

Less than (\<)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 < 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::



Greater than (\>)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 > 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::



Equal to (==)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 == 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::



Less than or equal to (\<=)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 <= 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::



Greater than or equal to (\>=)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 >= 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
8 >= 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::



Not equal to (!=)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
10 != 8
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::



## Logical Operators

AND operator (&)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
TRUE & TRUE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
TRUE & FALSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
FALSE & FALSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::



OR operator (\|)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
TRUE | TRUE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
TRUE | FALSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
FALSE | FALSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::



NOT operator (!)



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
!FALSE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
!TRUE
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE
```


:::
:::


:::

#### Data Types

Logical



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
status <- TRUE
status
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] TRUE
```


:::
:::



Integer / Numeric



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
age <- 48
age
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 48
```


:::
:::



Character



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
name <- "Traore"
name
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "Traore"
```


:::
:::



Vectors



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstars <- c('Messi', 'Ronaldo', 'Salah', 'Mbappe', 'Saka', 'Dembele')
superstars
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "Messi"   "Ronaldo" "Salah"   "Mbappe"  "Saka"    "Dembele"
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ages <- c(38, 39, 33, 26, 23, 28)
ages
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 38 39 33 26 23 28
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
world_cup_winner <- c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE)
world_cup_winner
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1]  TRUE FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE
```


:::
:::



Data frames



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstar_data <- data.frame(superstars, ages, world_cup_winner)
superstar_data
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  superstars ages world_cup_winner
1      Messi   38             TRUE
2    Ronaldo   39            FALSE
3      Salah   33            FALSE
4     Mbappe   26             TRUE
5       Saka   23            FALSE
6    Dembele   28             TRUE
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstar_data
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  superstars ages world_cup_winner
1      Messi   38             TRUE
2    Ronaldo   39            FALSE
3      Salah   33            FALSE
4     Mbappe   26             TRUE
5       Saka   23            FALSE
6    Dembele   28             TRUE
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstar_data %>% 
    mutate(year_of_birth = 2025 - ages,
           world_cup_win_yn = if_else(world_cup_winner == TRUE, "Yes", "No"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  superstars ages world_cup_winner year_of_birth world_cup_win_yn
1      Messi   38             TRUE          1987              Yes
2    Ronaldo   39            FALSE          1986               No
3      Salah   33            FALSE          1992               No
4     Mbappe   26             TRUE          1999              Yes
5       Saka   23            FALSE          2002               No
6    Dembele   28             TRUE          1997              Yes
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstar_data %>% 
    mutate(year_of_birth = 2025 - ages,
           world_cup_win_yn = if_else(world_cup_winner, "Yes", "No"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
  superstars ages world_cup_winner year_of_birth world_cup_win_yn
1      Messi   38             TRUE          1987              Yes
2    Ronaldo   39            FALSE          1986               No
3      Salah   33            FALSE          1992               No
4     Mbappe   26             TRUE          1999              Yes
5       Saka   23            FALSE          2002               No
6    Dembele   28             TRUE          1997              Yes
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
superstar_data %>% 
    mutate(superstars = if_else(superstars == "Salah", "Egyptian King", superstars))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
     superstars ages world_cup_winner
1         Messi   38             TRUE
2       Ronaldo   39            FALSE
3 Egyptian King   33            FALSE
4        Mbappe   26             TRUE
5          Saka   23            FALSE
6       Dembele   28             TRUE
```


:::
:::

:::



:::

```{.r .cell-code}

youngest
```
